governance_boundary.admin_product_control: Permitted operational actions exposing reviewed business workflows where a canonical adapter exists (e.g. view customer 360, inspect job state, approve manual topup draft with 3-layer proof, reply ticket).
governance_boundary.owner_production_gate: Strictly restricted actions requiring explicit Owner authorization. Includes raw database mutations, arbitrary balance edits, secret/ENV edits, unbounded systemctl console, and production queue mutations.

production_queue_mutation_policy.telemetry_level: READ_ONLY_OBSERVABILITY_ALLOWED (Worker heartbeats, outbox depths, and lease states are visible in Admin UI).
production_queue_mutation_policy.mutation_level: QUEUE_REDISPATCH_OWNER_GATED=YES. Re-queue, re-dispatch, and task retry mutations are production queue mutations. They require a canonical adapter, authorization check, audit receipt, proven idempotency, and fresh Owner authorization where required by production governance. Raw queue mutation is NOT an unrestricted Admin button.

autopost_authority_policy.web_role: Control surface and read projection only. Web App must NOT maintain a second authoritative asset handoff registry, publication ledger, scheduler, outbox, platform receipt store, or idempotency store.
autopost_authority_policy.bot_owns: PublishableAsset canonical resolution, HandoffReceipt, PublicationDraft state, publication, publication_attempt, schedule, outbox, receipt, claim/lease, idempotency, publish-only retry, transport adapters, platform receipt reconciliation.

matrix.admin_observability: View customer brief, scene progress, provider task state, Xu charge decision, final MP4 delivery receipt
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Cancel stuck job, inspect provider response
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: QUEUE_REDISPATCH_OWNER_GATED=YES: Task re-dispatch requires canonical adapter and audit receipt. NO direct mutation of raw SQLite video_jobs without audit outbox event.

matrix.admin_observability: View input media parameters, operation type (trim/concat/crop/watermark), FFmpeg execution state, output asset SHA
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Inspect processing logs, cancel stuck local/server FFmpeg task
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: Zero routing of cheap local FFmpeg tasks through paid AI provider APIs

matrix.admin_observability: View text script, speaker model, character count, audio duration, output MP3 delivery receipt
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Inspect provider payload, flag content policy violation
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: NO arbitrary provider API credentials mutation

matrix.admin_observability: View canonical publishable asset projection, scheduled timestamp, platform attempt history, platform receipt ID, retry counter (projected from Bot AutoPost Core)
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Approve scheduled post draft, request pause, trigger publish-only retry via canonical Bot AutoPost bridge
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: Publish-only retry must NOT rerun completed producer render. Web never issues direct SQL writes to Bot AutoPost tables; all writes call canonical Bot AutoPost API.

matrix.admin_observability: View payment code, proof reference, submitted VND, 3-layer reconciliation state
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Draft approve, confirm credit via canonical Bot bridge, reject with mandatory reason
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: Credit write is idempotent and goes exclusively through POST /internal/v1/admin/wallet/credit; NO raw balance table updates
matrix.canonical_authority: Web SQLite web_manual_topup_requests + Bot Core credit_events

matrix.admin_observability: View proven balance, lifetime deposit, ledger events count, reconciliation status
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Audit ledger only. Arbitrary balance modification PROHIBITED in UI (MANUAL_CREDIT_ACTIONS=0)
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: OWNER_PRODUCTION_GATE: Any non-standard wallet mutation requires Owner authorization and audited script

matrix.admin_observability: View customer issue, priority, message thread, related job ID / asset ID
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: NO deleting ticket history or audit trails

matrix.admin_observability: Current live prices, margins, draft revisions, publish history
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Draft price changes, calculate diff, publish to canonical catalog via bridge
